people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.
translations.bsb: Though Ephraim multiplied the altars for sin, they became his altars for sinning.
translations.kjv: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
translations.asv: Because Ephraim hath multiplied altars for sinning, altars have been unto him for sinning.
